privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how the Company ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects information when you use our mobile application and related services (the "Service").
privacy.section1_content:
We collect information to provide and improve the Service:

• Account Information: Email address, password (excluded for social login), display name
• Usage Data: Service usage records, feature interaction logs
• Automatically Collected: Device information (OS version, device model), app version, access logs
privacy.section2_content:
We use the collected information for the following purposes:

• Account Management: Verify identity, manage membership, prevent unauthorized use
• Service Delivery: Provide content, personalized features, and service improvements
• Analytics: Usage statistics and service quality improvement
privacy.section3_content:
We retain your information only as long as necessary for the purposes described in this policy:

• Account Information: Until account deletion (deleted immediately upon request)
• Usage Records: Up to 3 years (as required by applicable consumer protection laws)
• Access Logs: Up to 3 months (as required by applicable telecommunications laws)
privacy.section4_content:
We do not share your personal information with third parties except in the following cases:

• With your prior consent
• When required by law or legal process
• When requested by law enforcement authorities in accordance with applicable laws
privacy.section5_content:
When personal information is no longer necessary, we promptly destroy it:

• Electronic files: Permanently deleted using methods that prevent recovery
• Physical documents: Shredded or incinerated
privacy.section6_content:
You have the right to:

• Access your personal information
• Request correction of inaccurate information
• Request deletion of your information
• Request suspension of processing

You may exercise these rights through the app settings or by contacting our support team.
privacy.section7_content: For any questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the in-app support feature.

support.title: Support
support.intro: If something is not working or you have a question, contact us below. We reply in order of arrival.
support.contact_missing: No contact address is configured yet. See the company information screen in App Info.
support.report_content:
Including the following helps us reproduce the issue much faster.

• Device and OS version
• App version
• The screen where it happened and the steps to reproduce
• A screenshot, if possible
